Titel: SAP S/4HANA Finance Solution Architect (Freelance)
Unternehmen: Aurelian Consumer Brands B.V.

Quelle: LinkedIn

Abgerufen am: 17.09.2026 08:20

About the job
Aurelian Consumer Brands is running a group-wide finance transformation across 23 legal entities in Europe. We are looking for a freelance SAP S/4HANA Finance Solution Architect to own the end-to-end record-to-report design.

Your responsibilities
Own the solution design for record to report on SAP S/4HANA, including Central Finance and Group Reporting
Lead design authority sessions with finance process owners and the system integrator
Define the target chart of accounts, ledger approach and intercompany process
Review functional specifications and challenge customer-specific developments
Support data migration and reconciliation strategy for the first wave go-live

Your profile
10+ years of SAP FI/CO experience, including at least two S/4HANA implementations as lead or architect
Deep knowledge of Central Finance, Group Reporting and the Universal Journal
Background in consumer goods or retail is an advantage
Strong stakeholder management in an international setting
Fluent English is required, Dutch is not needed

Engagement
Start 1 December 2026, initial term 12 months
Day rate EUR 1,150, excluding VAT
Hybrid: remote work from the Netherlands, Belgium or Germany is possible; onsite in Amsterdam two days every other week
Contracting via our preferred supplier; for non-Dutch residents we can also arrange payrolling through an umbrella company

Seniority level
Mid-Senior level
Employment type
Contract
Job function
Finance and Information Technology
Industries
Manufacturing
